issues.title: [Downstream] frontend: new accessibility violation image-alt
issues.body:
Downstream's frontend check on !3 found this on the head build (e85e350d97d7) and not on the base build (7f2473276ae8). Started by @dev.

**Where it shows up**

- `home`: image-alt at `img` (Images must have alternative text)
- `repo`: image-alt at `img` (Images must have alternative text)
- `issues`: image-alt at `img` (Images must have alternative text)

Pages were rendered in happy-dom with the app's own JavaScript, three times: base twice, then head. A check that moved between the two base runs is withheld, not reported here.

Not checked: color-contrast, visual layout, real paint/CPU timing.

The `fix it` reply works on backend issues only; this one needs a human change.
